title: Restaurant website development | Creosote Labs
meta_description: Creosote Labs builds restaurant websites with editable menus, reservation and ordering links, and catering inquiry forms. Fixed price, no hourly billing.
h1: Website and web application development for restaurants
intro: A restaurant's website usually has to do a few specific jobs: show the current menu and hours, take reservations through OpenTable, Resy, or Tock, take online orders through Toast, Square, or a third-party app, and collect catering and private-event inquiries. Many restaurants run on a template site from Squarespace or Wix, or on a page the POS vendor provides, with the menu uploaded as a PDF that goes out of date. Online ordering and reservations often sit on separate services with their own branding and fees.

Creosote Labs builds restaurant websites and the customer-facing tools attached to them. A typical project is a marketing site with a menu that staff can edit from a phone, hours and location for search results, and reservation and ordering links wired to the systems the restaurant already uses. Where a template will not do, we build the tool directly, such as a private-dining inquiry form that produces a quote, or a gift card and merchandise store. Hosting, domain setup, and documentation are included.
projects: A marketing site with a menu editor managers update from a phone, so the printed menu and the web menu match.
A private-dining and catering inquiry form that collects date, headcount, and menu choices and returns a quote for the manager to confirm.
A direct online ordering page connected to the POS so orders print in the kitchen without a third-party commission.
A multi-location site with per-location hours, menus, and Google Business Profile data kept in sync.
An events calendar and ticket sales page for wine dinners, live music, and holiday seatings.

faqs.q: How are restaurant website projects priced?
faqs.a: Website and application projects are quoted after a scoping call, at a fixed price with no hourly billing. Hosting setup and domain configuration are included.

faqs.q: Can the new site keep the reservation and ordering systems a restaurant already uses?
faqs.a: Yes, the existing systems stay. We connect the site to the reservation and ordering services already in place, or build ordering directly into the site when that is the better fit.

faqs.q: What does the restaurant need to provide?
faqs.a: The restaurant provides the current menu, hours, photos, logo, and access to the domain registrar and any reservation or ordering accounts. We handle hosting, setup, and handover documentation.
